title: Bharat Last-Mile ID Level 2 gate_check_in Event
description: CloudEvents structured JSON representation of an LMID Level 2 gate_check_in event.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version used by this event.

id.description: Source-unique event identifier retained unchanged across webhook retries.

source.description: Canonical HTTPS origin formed from the verifier's bare participant domain and used for public-key discovery.

type.description: LMID event type asserted by this event.

time.description: UTC time at which the verifier recorded the successful pass check at the checkpoint.

datacontenttype.description: Media type of the event data object.

data.description: Minimal LMID pass and delivery correlation data for the checkpoint observation.

pass_jti.description: Exact jti of the successfully verified LMID pass.

deliveries.description: Delivery references from the verified pass covered by this checkpoint observation.

ref.description: Exact issuer-scoped delivery reference copied from one deliveries entry in the verified pass.
